description: Compare Google Docs voice typing vs Superwhisper for Mac. Find out which tool fits your workflow for dictation, privacy, and system-wide control.
targetKeyword: google docs voice typing vs superwhisper
intro: Google Docs voice typing is a free, browser-based tool for simple drafting, while Superwhisper provides a powerful, system-wide dictation experience for your Mac. If you need to dictate into any application, Superwhisper is the better choice, whereas Google Docs voice typing remains a basic option for those who never leave their browser.
tldr: Google Docs voice typing is free but limited to browser tabs.
Superwhisper works system-wide in any Mac application.
Lazur offers a complete assistant that sees your screen and helps you work.
Choose Google for quick, free notes; choose Superwhisper or Lazur for professional, cross-app workflows.

blocks.text: Google Docs voice typing is a built-in feature for the Google Docs web interface. You access it by clicking Tools > Voice typing in your browser. It is free for anyone with a Google account. The tool streams your audio to Google servers to process your speech in real time. It works well for short, simple paragraphs, but it stops working the moment you click away from your browser tab.

Superwhisper is a dedicated app for your Mac. It runs in the background and listens when you press your chosen shortcut. It supports system-wide dictation, meaning you can use it in Slack, Mail, or any other app. It offers local processing for privacy and supports complex workflows with custom prompts. You can choose to use your own API keys for advanced AI processing if you subscribe to their Pro plan.
Why choose Lazur for your Mac workflow

Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in your Mac notch. It does more than just type. When you hold ⌥ ⌘, Lazur sees your screen. You can ask it to explain a complex interface or point at a specific button you cannot find. It answers out loud and provides guidance one step at a time. It handles everyday tasks like setting reminders, checking your calendar, or managing your music. When you need to type, hold fn to dictate clean text directly into any app. Lazur keeps your data on your Mac and does not use your content to train models.

When you compare these tools, consider where you spend your time. If you only write in Google Docs, the built-in tool is enough. If you write in many apps, you need a system-wide solution. Superwhisper excels at speed and app integration. Lazur excels at helping you navigate your Mac and answering questions about your screen content.

blocks.caption: Comparison of voice tools for Mac users.

blocks.text: Google Docs voice typing sends your audio to cloud servers. These recordings may be used to improve Google services. Superwhisper emphasizes privacy with local processing on Apple Silicon Macs. Lazur ensures that your screen data and audio are only sent to AI providers when you hold the shortcut. Your data is not stored or used for model training.
Choosing the right tool for your needs

Pick Google Docs voice typing if you need a free, zero-setup tool for occasional web-based writing. Pick Superwhisper if you need a high-speed, system-wide dictation tool with deep customization. Pick Lazur if you want an assistant that can see your screen, guide you through app menus, and handle your daily Mac tasks while providing clean dictation.

faq.question: Is Google Docs voice typing free?
faq.answer: Yes, it is included at no additional cost with any standard Google account.

faq.question: Does Superwhisper work offline?
faq.answer: Yes, Superwhisper supports offline transcription, which works best on Apple Silicon Macs.

faq.question: Can Lazur operate my apps for me?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It points, explains, and guides you so you can perform the work yourself.

verdict: If you are a casual user who only writes in Google Docs, the built-in voice typing is sufficient. For those who need to dictate across multiple apps, Superwhisper is a strong choice. If you want a voice assistant that can see your screen, guide you through tasks, and handle your daily Mac interactions, choose Lazur.
